name: Notion Publish Status — TAG (PR merge → Status: Published + IndexNow + Google Indexing API)

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filter: { property: 'PR URL', url: { equals: $json.prUrl } }, page_size: 1 }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ text: `📰 Notion topic marked Published\n*PR #${$('Resolve Page').first().json.prNumber}:* ${$('Resolve Page').first().json.prTitle}\nLive on ${$('Resolve Page').first().json.postUrl} after Netlify finishes (~90s).` }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ host: $('Resolve Page').first().json.siteHost, key: $('Resolve Page').first().json.indexNowKey, keyLocation: $('Resolve Page').first().json.indexNowKeyLocation, urlList: [$('Resolve Page').first().json.postUrl] }) }}

nodes.name: IndexNow Submit
nodes.notes: Pings IndexNow (Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo, Naver, Seznam). neverError:true so a 4xx/5xx here can't fail the workflow — the Status update to Notion already happened. 200 = accepted, 202 = accepted-with-warnings, 422 = unprocessable (usually a key/keyLocation mismatch).

nodes.name: Google Indexing Submit
nodes.notes: Officially the Indexing API is gated to JobPosting + BroadcastEvent schemas. In practice Google accepts blog post URLs and uses them as a strong recrawl signal. neverError:true means a 403 (quota/scope) or 429 (quota exceeded) won't fail the workflow — the Status/IndexNow steps already happened.
